user_personas.name: Sarah - Working Professional Student
goals: Understand how to implement AI strategy in her organization
pain_points: Needs quick clarification on complex concepts
Wants real-world examples, not just theory

user_personas.name: Dr. Martinez - Course Instructor
pain_points: Difficult to identify struggling students early
needs: Automated first-line support for common questions
Alerts for students who need intervention

functional.description: AI tutor must answer student questions about AI strategy concepts with context awareness of course materials
System adapts to student's knowledge level and recommends next topics based on performance
Present real-world AI strategy scenarios for students to analyze, provide detailed feedback
Regular knowledge checks, track mastery of key concepts (Bloom's taxonomy)
Break down complex AI strategy frameworks (Porter's 5 Forces + AI, AI Transformation Playbook, etc.)
Integrate with Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle via LTI 1.3
Track student engagement, concept mastery, time spent, for both students and instructors
Responsive web design, mobile apps (iOS/Android), always available

non_functional.requirement: Response time < 3 seconds for 95% of queries
non_functional.rationale: Students need quick feedback to maintain engagement
Multiple courses, peak times during assignment deadlines

non_functional.requirement: 90%+ accuracy on concept explanations (validated by instructors)

acceptance_criteria: Student can ask a question and receive contextually relevant answer within 3 seconds
System correctly identifies student's current knowledge level within first 3 interactions
Personalized recommendations improve student test scores by 15%+ vs control group
Case study feedback includes specific, actionable suggestions for improvement
Instructor can view class-wide analytics dashboard showing concept mastery
System integrates with LMS via LTI 1.3 with SSO
Mobile interface scores 90+ on Google Lighthouse for accessibility
90% of student questions answered without instructor escalation

student_outcomes.learning_efficiency: Time to concept mastery reduced by 25%
student_outcomes.test_performance: Average scores improve 15% with tutor usage

instructor_outcomes.visibility: 100% of instructors use analytics dashboard weekly

constraints: Timeline: MVP in 3 months for pilot with 1 course
Team: 2 engineers, 1 AI/ML specialist, 1 instructional designer
Technology: Must use existing university cloud infrastructure (AWS)
Compliance: FERPA, GDPR (for international students), accessibility standards
Integration: Must work with existing LMS (Canvas primary)

user_stories.acceptance: Question answered with relevant examples within 3 seconds

user_stories.so_that: I can apply theoretical knowledge to practical scenarios
user_stories.acceptance: Case presented, student submits analysis, receives detailed feedback

user_stories.so_that: I can focus my study time on areas where I'm weakest
user_stories.acceptance: Dashboard shows mastery % for each major topic/framework

user_stories.i_want: to see which concepts students struggle with most
user_stories.so_that: I can adjust my teaching and provide targeted support
user_stories.acceptance: Analytics show most-asked questions and lowest-scoring concepts

user_stories.i_want: to review and approve AI tutor responses
user_stories.so_that: I can ensure educational quality and accuracy
user_stories.acceptance: Instructor dashboard for reviewing/editing tutor responses
